title: perf: simply work done in parse_tag a bit

verdicts.label: intended
verdicts.rationale: The head version's docstring for `parse_tag` explicitly states it raises `InvalidTag` on empty tag components, and the `InvalidTag` class is documented as added in version 26.3. The change from a generic `ValueError` to the more specific `InvalidTag` subclass is therefore deliberate.
evidence: .. versionadded:: 26.3 … Raises :class:`InvalidTag` on empty tag components.
rejected: if '' in parts: raise InvalidTag(f'Tag {tag!r} has an empty component: {component!r}')
verdicts.facts: Outcome differs. Input ["Ensure platform tags normalize spaces to underscores."]: base raises builtins.ValueError, head raises packaging.tags.InvalidTag. (packaging.tags.InvalidTag is a subclass of builtins.ValueError.)
